description: meme-watch returns a rolling 60-minute feed of Solana memecoin launches inside a JSON object. POST /v1/launches with an optional dex filter (pumpfun, pumpswap, meteora_daam_v2, meteora_dbc; omit for every venue) plus optional limit, max_age_minutes, min_txns, min_volume_usd, min_liquidity_usd, named_only, sort and format. Each launch carries pool and token address, venue, creation time, name and symbol, price, fully diluted value, quote-side reserve, since-launch volume and transaction count, buy and sell split, volume per transaction, 5-minute price change, and drawdown from its all-time high. Set format to csv and the table rides in the csv string field. The backend polls upstream on a fixed budget and answers from cache, so results are point-in-time and two suppliers legitimately differ. Each supplier needs its own DexPaprika API key.

rpc_types.notes: POST /v1/launches, GET /v1/version, GET /healthz, GET /v1/capabilities, and GET /v1/openapi.json are expected. Every response is a JSON object; when csv format is requested the table rides in the 'csv' string field, always last. All inputs are read from the POST body; no query string or caller header is relied upon.

specs.notes: The same document is served by the backend at GET /v1/openapi.json. Add sha256 once the URL is frozen.

serving.backend: The meme-watch container (Node 22, no runtime dependencies; built from services/meme-watch/backend) behind the HA RelayMiner. It polls DexPaprika every 120 seconds under a hard monthly credit governor and holds the window in memory, mirrored to a CSV on a small persistent volume, so every relay is served from cache and never waits on an upstream call. Each supplier must set its own key in MW_DEXPAPRIKA_API_KEY; without one it falls back to the keyless tier and the feed thins. Light on CPU and memory.

healthcheck.notes: Identity probe: pins the backend to this service so a wrong backend cannot be staked under this id.
Readiness probe: 200 only once the first poll has completed and the window holds data.
Functional probe: exercises the query path and asserts the declared window. Structural rather than data-dependent, because the feed changes every poll.

serving.notes: Every request is a POST JSON body to /v1/launches, answered from memory in milliseconds. The response carries as_of and complete_before so a consumer can tell a quiet minute from one still being indexed upstream, and pending_identity for launches discovered but not yet named. Gateway operators: type passthrough, rpc_types ["rest"], relay_timeout at least 10s; see sage-service.yaml in the service repository.
